lede: Tulane carries the stronger underlying team rating — +1.2 against -3.8, a 5.0-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Tulane -17.2 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Tulane winning 87% of simulations.

Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
